name: Cube Against Cancer Arizona 2026
information: This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerArizona2026#69306-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEF2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8251573b328b2e062c683f33bccc9e924b923d20/170aa7c0467a35c79617e6895b87b17f34553486.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MzM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--269110cca5292e77fc6565ac976ac5981f0ebe06/ArizonaCubingLogo.png) Connect with the Arizona cubing community! Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/) Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing) This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BringtheHeatAZ2025#60273-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
